name: vrs-lib
description: Restores this thread's exact pre-compaction originals (vrs_restore), byte ranges of its rollout (vrs_read), and searches every Claude Code session and app thread on this PC (vrs_search). SWEGCA VRS-MRP: Verification-Reinforced Synapse, Memory Recovery Plugin.

interface.longDescription: After this thread is compacted, vrs_restore returns the exact user messages and answers that left the live context, with their rollout positions and SHA-256; vrs_read returns an exact byte range of the rollout; vrs_search finds the turns of every Claude Code session and app thread on this PC that answer a query, the strongest remembered ones verbatim.
